name: xpowers
description: Structured engineering workflows for Kimi Code CLI: brainstorming, TDD, planning, autonomous execution, and multi-agent reviews.
skillInstructions: XPowers is tm-first. Check tm ready for work, use test-driven-development for implementation, and run verification-before-completion before claiming success. When delegating, use the built-in subagents: explore for research, plan for architecture, coder for implementation/review/testing.

interface.shortDescription: Structured engineering workflows for Kimi Code CLI
interface.longDescription: XPowers adds reusable skills for brainstorming, writing plans, executing plans autonomously, test-driven development, bug fixing, refactoring, and parallel review. It assumes a tm-first task tracker backend.
